The transfer rows train on the Control Tax backdoors and test on the GPT-4-era APPS backdoors. The no-code classifier reads difficulty, test count and question length. \emph{Comments}: stripped from both classes or kept; \emph{no code}: the baseline never reads the program. Rows with comments kept are inflated by the comments and are given for contrast. \emph{Against}: how many of the 24 monitors the value is above, or what it is compared with (the DSPy tutorial's monitor: 0.69--0.81).
